service.name: Another Sil'dihn Subterrane
service.longDescription: The retelling of your adventures has set Osmon's imagination aflame with visions of perilous passages and mighty sentinels. He wonders, however, if dwelling in the damp has weakened the guardians; if, before rust and decay set in, that they had once been far more powerful. You cannot help but ponder the possibilities, your thoughts drifting as Osmon's hypothetical scenario plays out in your mind...
